name: Hypothesis Test
description: Runs one hypothesis test over the input and returns a single row: test, statistic, df, p_value, n. Supported tests: two-sample (Welch) and paired Student's t, one-sample t, chi-square test of independence and one-way ANOVA. p-values are computed by the engine's own incomplete beta/gamma implementation because DuckDB has no erf/beta.

value.title: Value column
value.description: Numeric measurement column for the t tests and ANOVA, categorical column for chi_square.

group.title: Group column
group.description: Categorical grouping column for t_test_two_sample, chi_square and anova.

group_a.title: First group
group_a.description: t_test_two_sample/chi_square: a value of the group column, compared as text. t_test_paired: the first numeric column.

group_b.title: Second group
group_b.description: t_test_two_sample/chi_square: a value of the group column, compared as text. t_test_paired: the second numeric column.

alpha.title: Significance level
alpha.description: Validated to be in (0, 1); the p_value is returned and the caller compares it.

alternative.title: Alternative hypothesis
alternative.description: Tail used by the t tests; chi_square and anova always use the upper tail.
